packages.name: Clinic Automation Package
packages.tagline: Everything your clinic needs - from patient booking to follow-up reminders.
packages.description: A complete automation package for clinics that reduces no-shows, frees up reception and ensures every patient interaction is handled professionally - from first enquiry to post-visit follow-up.
problems: Patients call repeatedly for simple booking tasks
Reception spends hours on reminder calls before each day
No-shows create costly empty appointment slots
Follow-up reminders are missed, affecting patient health
benefits: Receptionist time returned to patients who need it most
No-shows dramatically reduced with automatic reminders
Every patient enquiry answered, even after hours
Consistent, professional communication across the whole journey

faqs: Will it replace our current booking system?
It can work alongside what you already use, or take over completely. We set it up based on what works best for your clinic.
How long until we see the benefit?
Most clinics see a clear drop in no-shows and missed calls within the first month.
Can it handle multiple doctors or rooms?
Yes - multi-provider scheduling, rooms and services are all supported.
Do we need technical staff?
No. We set everything up, train your team and handle all maintenance. Your reception uses WhatsApp and a dashboard they already understand.

faqs: Can different exhibitor packages be registered?
Yes - exhibitors select their package in the flow, pricing is confirmed and the booking is locked automatically.

Yes - via M-Pesa or Stripe. Payment confirmation triggers the ticket or exhibitor brief automatically.
Will visitors get reminders?
Yes - two reminders before the event with date, time and venue details.
Can we use it for conference events too?
Absolutely - the same flow works for conferences, workshops and any event with exhibitor and visitor registration.
